verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's first-party product page says its AI code reviewer reviews all code changes and suggests fixes so teams can merge faster, which addresses the story's core of faster initial review by an AI. The evidence is only a repeated one-line marketing claim, so how the reviewer is assigned or triggered is not documented. Missing for 10: documentation of how the AI reviewer is assigned to a pull request (e.g., as a reviewer or by automatic trigger), detail on review scope and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
